marketed_identity: AUL Instruments; Guild Foxey Lady OEM
model_or_product: Foxey Lady V2 / early Matthews fuzz boxes
evidence_summary: AUL Instruments in Long Island City/New York is documented as a contract manufacturer for Mike Matthews' pre-Electro-Harmonix fuzz production and for Guild-branded Foxey Lady units. Historical sources distinguish the AUL-built grey folded-steel version from earlier Mosrite production and later Electro-Harmonix production. Preserve AUL as the physical manufacturer, with Mike Matthews, Guild and the Foxey Lady marketed identity represented separately.

model_or_product: FZ002 gated bass fuzz; Brown Dog successor
evidence_summary: Richard Cartwright's Australian effects company began in 1995 and developed a documented commercial bass-fuzz line. The FZ002 was handmade in Australia and later superseded by the Brown Dog, which contemporary discussion describes as a reengineered version of the FZ002. Preserve FZ002 and Brown Dog as one builder lineage with a product-generation relationship rather than separate manufacturers.
